steps.name: Login request
steps.done: The request has a Sign in on iPhone button

steps.name: Native browser
steps.goal: Open the native browser by tapping Sign in on iPhone only if the card is still visible. Once Website login is visible, wait for the test page. Do not tap Use login or Transfer login in this step.
steps.done: The native browser is open: its title is Website login and the page has a Sign in to test site link. This step does not sign in or transfer anything.

steps.name: Website sign-in
steps.goal: Tap Sign in to test site in the web page

steps.name: Transfer consent
steps.goal: Tap Use login in the navigation bar
steps.done: A native alert asks permission to transfer the login
expect: Use this login on your computer?

steps.name: Approved transfer
steps.goal: Tap Transfer login to approve the login transfer
steps.done: The request card says the login was transferred and the agent was notified
expect: Login transferred. The agent has been notified.
